issues.text: This commit re-lands a previously reverted flexbox change but only replays four of the six originally-changed files, omitting the paired desktop/mobile header adjustments that the layout depends on.
issues.zh: 重新落地被 revert 的 flexbox 改動時，漏掉 desktop/mobile header 的配套調整。

issues.text: The .panel element now relies on margin-left: auto for positioning, but that technique has no effect under the legacy 2009 box-model syntax (-webkit-box/-moz-box) that this same mixin set deliberately outputs, and float was removed with no fallback for browsers that don't support flexbox at all (e.g. IE9, which is listed as a minimum supported browser).
issues.zh: .panel 改用 margin-left: auto 定位，但這個技巧在本 mixin 特地支援的舊 flexbox 語法下無效，移除 float 後也沒有留下 fallback。

issues.text: The align-items() mixin is missing the -moz-box-align declaration even though the sibling flexbox() and order() mixins do output the -moz-box prefix, so Firefox versions relying on the -moz-box fallback get no vertical alignment at all.
issues.zh: align-items() mixin 缺少 -moz-box-align，-moz-box fallback 拿不到對齊。

issues.text: align-items() passes modern alignment keywords (flex-start/flex-end) straight through to legacy-syntax properties that only accept start/end, so those values silently produce invalid, ignored declarations.
issues.zh: align-items() 把現代關鍵字原封不動轉給舊語法屬性，flex-start / flex-end 會靜默失效。

issues.text: The left padding on .small-action-desc was changed, but a mobile-only override (margin-left: -40px) that was calibrated against the old padding value was not updated, misaligning content on mobile.
issues.zh: .small-action-desc 的 4em 左 padding 被移除，但 mobile 端依賴該值的 margin-left: -40px 沒有跟著調整。

issues.text: @include order(2) is applied to .extra-info-wrapper, but that element is not a direct flex item of .contents (it's nested inside an Ember component wrapper div), so the order declaration has no effect; the visually-correct ordering currently happens to work only by source order.
issues.zh: .extra-info-wrapper 上的 @include order(2) 不會生效——它不是 .contents 的 flex item。

issues.text: -ms-align-items is not a real CSS property that any version of IE ever implemented, so this declaration in align-items() is always dead weight.
order() maps its value directly onto the 1-based legacy *-box-ordinal-group property, so @include order(0) (the modern default) would produce an invalid, discarded declaration.
issues.zh: order() 把值直接映到 1-based 的 *-box-ordinal-group，@include order(0) 會產生無效宣告。

issues.text: The new align-items() mixin uses 4-space indentation while the rest of mixins.scss uses 2-space indentation.
issues.zh: align-items() 內部用 4 空格縮排，mixins.scss 其餘 mixin 一律 2 空格。

issues.text: A new line in the mixin file has trailing whitespace.
issues.zh: mixins.scss 的 -ms-flex-align: $alignment; 行尾有兩個多餘空白。

issues.text: A new declaration is missing the space after the colon that other declarations in the same mixin have (align-items:$alignment; vs align-items: $alignment;).
issues.zh: align-items:$alignment; 冒號後缺空格，同 mixin 內其他行都有。

issues.text: The vendor-prefix ordering differs between the flexbox() and inline-flex() mixins even though they express the same mapping, making them harder to compare at a glance.
issues.zh: flexbox() 與 inline-flex() 的前綴排列順序不同。

issues.text: .small-action-desc's horizontal padding was changed to a percentage value, which resolves relative to the container width and therefore varies unpredictably between desktop (fixed-width container) and mobile (no width limit), inconsistent with the fixed-unit spacing used elsewhere in the same file.
issues.zh: .small-action-desc 的左右間距改用百分比，會隨容器寬度浮動。

issues.text: The clearfix class on .contents is now a no-op (and introduces two extra empty flex items) now that .contents is a flex container, since float has no effect on flex items and there's nothing left to clear.
issues.zh: .contents 成為 flex container 後，template 上的 clearfix class 已無作用，且會多出兩個看不見的 flex item。

open_questions.text: What was the actual reason the earlier commit (2ad2ab5) was reverted, and does adding vendor prefixes actually address that reason?
open_questions.zh: 83593fe 當初 revert 2ad2ab5 的實際原因是什麼？「補上所有 prefix」是否真的處理掉了那個原因？

open_questions.text: Does IE10's -ms-flexbox implementation honor margin-left: auto for pushing .panel to the right, given IE10 implements an intermediate draft of the flexbox spec with known divergences?
open_questions.zh: IE10 的 -ms-flexbox 實作是否會讓 flex item 上的 margin-left: auto 吸收剩餘空間，把 .panel 推到右側？
